descriptor: Menu animation experiments for interface designers

voice.summary: Foldline Labs sounds like a design studio's experiment bench: clear instructions, light humour and exact numbers. It labels each animation like a lab sample.
dos: Name each morph and show its speed and easing
Keep jokes to the odd pun on lines and folds
donts: Never skip the Escape and focus details

taglines: Pick a morph, tune the timing
Fold it, flip it, close it
boilerplate: Foldline Labs is an experiment bench for interface designers, offering six animated menu icon morphs with live speed and easing controls tested on a real slide-in menu.

microcopy.error: That setting is out of range. Try 100 to 800 ms.

logo.note: Three horizontal bars are the hamburger itself and the thing the lab bends.
